issue_context.title: Investigate golangci-lint to simplify our verify-* scripts
issue_context.body:
A lot of our go verification scripts are included in [golangci-lint](https://github.com/golangci/golangci-lint), which is designed to aggregate the tools for CI. It looks like the following are included:

- govet
- golint
- gofmt
- misspell
- staticcheck (https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/81189)

This tool might be able to simplify our verify scripts, as it encapsulates some of the functionality. Also, by aggregating the linters it may be much faster than running each tool independently. Finally, it would make adding new linters (supported by golangci-lint) much easier.
